chunks: (And) said: 'Look! This is what you have honoured above me! If You defer (my term) till the Day of Resurrection, I will bring his progeny into complete subjugation, barring a few.'
ai.seo_question: What did Iblis promise Allah regarding Adam's descendants if given time until the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This declaration by Iblis, recorded in Surah Al-Isra, highlights the strategic shift from his initial arrogance to a targeted campaign against humanity, specifically targeting the 'qalil' (few) who remain steadfast. Shia scholarship often interprets this 'small number' as the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who serve as the spiritual anchors preserving faith amidst widespread deviation. The verse underscores the reality of fitnah (trial) as a divine test, where Satan's persistent whispering is countered by the guidance of the Infallibles.
